rows.en: Yamato: "Hey, what are we doing now?"
Touya: "...Let's go to the bridge for now..."
Yamato: "Oh, watch out, meow!"
Touya: "Huh...?"
Touya: "Ow!"
Celica: "Ow, ow, ow..."
Yamato: "Oh, Celica."
Touya: "...Are you all right?"
Celica: "Huh? Y-Yeah. I'm fiiine."
Celica: "See? Just like this."
Touya: "...Looks like it."
Celica: "You're going to the bridge now, right?
Then let's go together."
Touya: "Huh? Well, I don't mind..."
Celica: "Then, forward march!"
Celica: "...Hey, have you gotten used to living here?"
Touya: "Not enough time has passed for that."
Celica: "...Fair enough. But you're starting to have
a warrior's eyes."
Touya: "...I'm not fighting because I like it."
Celica: "Hmm, did I put that badly?
I'm not saying you're enjoying it.
How do I put it? I'm happy."
Touya: "Huh?"
Celica: "Your synchronization readings with the Spirit Mech
seem to have no limit.
This is a first for me.
The more I tinker with it,
the more you respond... It's really exciting."
Touya: "..."
Celica: "I'm so happy someone has appeared who can use the Zeifon
this well.
I never thought I'd feel like this."
Touya: "...You're weird."
Celica: "Maybe. But so are you."
Touya: "Me?"
Celica: "Yes. Your data shows amazing results,
but inside, you're struggling and worrying...
Don't be so hard on yourself."
Touya: "..."
Celica: "The way you fight is reckless.
Is it because of your parents after all?"
Touya: "..."
Celica: "I heard they died after getting caught up in a terrorist attack.
It feels like you're using that pain and sadness
as strength to fight."
Touya: "...That's not it. I did get swept into fighting,
but I think I've accepted it in my own way..."
Celica: "Isn't denying it like that proof that it bothers you?
If you'd overcome it, at least you wouldn't bring up some other reason
to deny it, would you?"
Touya: "..."
Celica: "I haven't had that kind of experience, so I can't irresponsibly
tell you to cheer up or live positively.
But as long as you keep dwelling on it like that,
nothing will change, will it?
You need to face it properly... But you know that already."
Touya: "...If I could do that, I wouldn't be struggling.
Even if I understand it in my head, I can't do it..."
Celica: "That's true.
That's more or less why I chose a path where I could live
only in a world of theory too..."
Touya: "?"
Celica: "Oh! H-Hahaha... It's nothing!
Anyway, what I wanted to say was that you should take things
a little easier. And not worry all by yourself.
When you look ahead, you might see things
you couldn't see before."
Touya: "...Heh."
Celica: "Besides, if you died, I wouldn't be able to collect
any more good data."
Touya: "Hey, come on..."
Celica: "Hahaha! I'm counting on you.
Well... I'll go on ahead."
Yamato: "...She's gone."
Touya: "Yeah."
Yamato: "I guess she was trying to be considerate, meow?"
Touya: "Who knows? Well, maybe I was overthinking it.
A fight's still a fight, though."
Yamato: "...It's difficult."
Touya: "Yeah. Well, shall we go too?"
Yamato: "Yeah."
